[Intro]
[C5]

[C5]The sound of
silent
voices

Regularity
de-

fection
Neither
sorrow
nor con-

Whispering
emptiness
Whispering
empti-

[Break]
[C5]ness
Frail words col-
lapse
My weight
only stirs the
ground
How long can
I hold hand
as you
walk over

[Verse 4]
[C5]graves?
[F5]
[G#5]You search for
[G5]tears
[C5]
[F5]

[G5]passion

[F5]
[G#5]the comfort
[G5]of winter
[C5]Yet
[F5]find
[G#5]of
[G5]winter

[Solo]
[C5]
[D#5]
[G#5]
[G5]
[C5]

[Outro]
[C5]
Reassurance
dead
like you

Losing hope
in your unchanging
ways
All of my
strength can save you
If you are
unwilling to
help
